feedback: Present the pending-exclusion notice as a centered standard warning below each complete tax report, only when pending entries exist.
instruction: For General Tax and Income Tax reports, render one themed, centered, non-dismissable ElAlert warning after both tables and totals, including net taxable income where present, only if either section contains a pending row. Retain positive and negative page coverage, require alert semantics on the positive path, and inspect both rendered reports.
reason: The precise placement and alignment are report-specific product preferences. Existing guidance already covers shared themed presentation and page-owned conditional coverage; a new active rule would overgeneralize this correction.
